- Density of gold = 19.3 g/cm^3

   Mass of 1 mole = (3.27 × 10^-22 g/atom) × (6.022 × 10^23 atoms/mol) = 196.9 g/mol

2) Then, I'll find the volume using the density formula:
   Volume = Mass ÷ Density
